milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The target is the center of the dark oak planks structure's front wall at spawn-relative (6, 2, 3). max_distance=8 ensures the player has actively approached the structure (it's ~7 blocks from spawn but the player starts facing slightly away, so they must turn and move toward it). facing_tolerance=60 confirms the player is visually observing the dark_oak_planks.

Uses inventory_has for 'book' because mining a bookshelf without Silk Touch drops exactly 3 books. The player has a wooden axe (no Silk Touch) and starts with zero books in inventory. Having 3+ books confirms at least one bookshelf was successfully mined. This is preferred over position-based checks since the mined drop ends up in inventory and directly verifies the mining action occurred.
